exposure: Oral stimulation (OS) + Nonnutritive sucking (NNS) + Tactile/Kinesthetic (T/K) intervention
outcome: Transition time from tube feeding to independent oral feeding
Weight gain at full oral feeding
cohort: The study included 130 preterm infants who were separated into two intervention groups (OS+NNS and OS+NNS+T/K) and one control group.
finding: OS + NNS and OS + NNS + T/K interventions significantly shortened the transition time from tube feeding to independent oral feeding and improved weight gain in preterm infants compared to a control group, with the combined OS + NNS + T/K group demonstrating superior results.
followup_time: Approximately 7-12 days (duration until independent oral feeding was achieved)
